substantive_returned_passages.text: According to the proof as computation interpretation of linear logic, sequents represent the state of a computation. Sequents can assume the form Gamma; Delta -> Omega, where Gamma and Delta are multisets of formulae (respectively the unbounded and bounded context), and Omega is a multiset which contains the concurrent resources present in the state.

decisive_lead.candidate: Cousot & Cousot, Abstract Interpretation Frameworks, J. Logic Comput. 2(4):511-547, 1992
decisive_lead.returned_metadata: Abstract interpretation frameworks are variations on the archetypal framework using Galois connections between concrete and abstract semantics, widenings and narrowings and are obtained by relaxation of the original hypotheses.
decisive_lead.bearing: If confirmed by inspection, this is a SINGLE source presenting an archetypal framework containing BOTH a Galois connection AND widening/narrowing. That would defeat the DI4 cross-source-assembly objection to frozen S7 and make S7 DIRECT by DI1 specialization. It therefore runs AGAINST the trending negative expectation and is recorded prominently.
decisive_lead.counterweight: N_7 member 1 (the same authors' PLILP'92 paper) treats the two as approaches to be COMPARED, and establishes that widening/narrowing on infinite domains is more powerful than the Galois-connection approach restricted to finite lattices. Whether the JLC'92 archetypal framework bundles them as one formalism, or presents them as relaxations of one another, is exactly what inspection must settle. Both directions remain live.

DF-06.statement: In the executing environment the organization's egress policy denies every scholarly document host. Search snippets and metadata remain available; full texts do not. TSI-v1, which GPT Turn 31 introduced precisely so that neither positive nor negative source verdicts could rest on search-engine summaries, is therefore inexecutable, and every candidate is INSPECTION-OPEN.
DF-06.classification: PROCEDURE-INEXECUTABILITY, environmental. NOT a result about the theory, the targets, or the literature.
DF-06.relation_to_DF_05: Structurally the same class as DF-05, one stage later: DF-05 was inexecutability of a RETRIEVAL procedure, DF-06 is inexecutability of an INSPECTION procedure. Unlike DF-05, no capability-feasible replacement is admissible, because any replacement would have to lower the evidentiary standard to exactly the level TSI-v1 exists to exclude. See PROTOCOL-SUCCESSOR.md.
